profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: AWS certified software engineer with full stack experience designing, building, testing, and deploying web applications, Rest APIs, and mobile applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Honeywell Quantum Solutions
positions.description:
- Developed serverless applications using AWS API Gateway, Lambdas (Python), and DynamoDB
- Led development of React web application and accompanying AWS serverless backend
- Added support for Honeywell Quantum Machine to open source quantum programming frameworks

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Main Developer for an internal data analytics tool that uses AWS SQS and S3 that was critical for allowing data analysts to migrate their processes to the cloud
• Gathered requirements from users, designed and developed frontend and backend features in Java and Scala, wrote unit tests, and deployed changes to production
• Created backend and frontend features using Python/Flask and TypeScript/React for enterprise application that is built upon Jupyter and JupyterLab
• Migrated application to production AWS account and brought up stacks using AWS CoudFormation, Route53, ECS, and Docker

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Created Epic's first real-time free-text search system by designing a RESTful Web API in C# and a SQL indexer using Elasticsearch
•	Created front end that queries the search API using ASP.NET

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Constructed a Javascript Graphing API from scratch that was used by myself and other teams to create specialized medical graphs
•	Created data visualizations using d3.js and integrated them into an enterprise application

positions.title: Engineering Assistant Intern
positions.description: •	Worked for local chemical plant by helping in the engineering department . Used plant-wide Aspen database system to modify critical values. Learned how the work flows in a large place of work

honors.title: Steenbock Youth Music Award
honors.description: I was the second place winner of the Bolz Young Artist Competition, a highly regarded statewide competition in which Wisconsin’s young musicians compete for scholarships and the opportunity to perform as soloists with the MSO. I played the violin as a soloist with the MSO in front of a live TV audience of thousands worldwide in Madison's Overture Hall, and won a scholarship of $2,000.
honors.issuer: Issued by Madison Symphony Orchestra · Apr 2013

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteered for Habitat for Humanity, we were tasked with cleaning out the house of a tenant who moved out and left behind much of their belongings.

projects.title: The Resistance - Web Version
projects.description: •	Adapted a board game to be playable as a mobile web application using Angular, Node.js, and Mongo

projects.title: AvalonCast
projects.description: Designed an Android application and Chromecast application that interface with each other. Was Team Leader of a group of four software engineers. Solved complex technical problems regarding communication between up to 11 devices.

organizations.name: UW Madison Aikido & Jujitsu Club
organizations.position: Competition and Social Media Officer · Sep 2016 - Jun 2017
organizations.description: I am one of the most involved officers for UW Madison's Aikido & Jujitsu Club. I helped facilitate the process of merging UW Madison's Aikdio club and Jujitsu club into one club. I completely revamped the club's social media presence and boosted our membership rate by 300%. I introduced competitions to the club by going to the first ever BJJ competition on the behalf of our club, and stimulated new members' interest in competing as well.
